name: Dao Lhong Fah Bhu Bha Si Ngern
original_name: ดาวหลงฟ้า ภูผาสีเงิน
overview: It's mainly about a princess of a fictional country falling in love with a normal soldier. The main point of distinguishment of this drama is the casting of an actual member of the Thai royal family as well as the elites.
